transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function whose body is the Rust 1.96 target delegation `cmp::SliceContains::slice_contains(x, self)`, adapted only by naming the receiver parameter `slice`.

Modeled `core::slice::cmp::SliceContains::slice_contains` as a target-local trait/specialization boundary carrying only the generated contains relation. This covers the default PartialEq iterator path and primitive specializations without externalizing the public target.

Added the generated `slice_contains_value` / `partial_eq_observed` vocabulary as the Verus ensures clause on the target and the narrow trait/specialization boundary; this records the contract under test and does not assume the target body.
